articles.title_en: Russia’s FSB says it detained 46 users of a Telegram dating bot, ages 12 to 22, whom Ukrainian intelligence recruited for sabotage. But the chats in the videos offered as proof are on a Russian app.
articles.lead_en: Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) said it had detained 46 users of Leonardo Daivinchik, a popular Telegram dating bot. All of them are young Russians between the ages of 12 and 22, and all of them, the FSB claims, were recruited by Ukrainian intelligence services to commit crimes in Russia.

articles.title_en: The battlefield Ukraine’s new commander-in-chief inherits as Russian troops push toward Ukraine’s main defensive stronghold in Donbas
articles.lead_en: Ukraine’s new commander-in-chief, Mykhailo Drapatyi, inherited a difficult situation on the front lines from his predecessor, Oleksandr Syrskyi. In the first half of the year, the Ukrainian army managed to hold back the Russian offensive in the northern part of Donbas, but in recent weeks Russian forces have accelerated their advance toward their main objective — the Kramatorsk and Sloviansk agglomeration.
